description: Building-level broadband, cellular, latency, outage, provider intelligence.
notes: Coded against the Kit contract with a guarded inline fallback shim (window.Kit || ...); the real shared/kit.js landed mid-build and takes precedence — all 10 verified against the real kit: zero console/page errors, core interactions clicked, 1280x800 shot captured.

notes.note: Advertised-vs-measured speeds per address is genuinely useful for remote workers choosing where to live. But the data already exists in fragments (Ookla, FCC maps), and the $499/mo ISP dashboard assumes ISPs will pay to see their own underperformance quantified — churn-defense is plausible but it's a slow enterprise sale.

notes.change: stat cards (.k-kpis) stacked full-width because shared kit.css has no .k-kpis layout rule; added flex row with wrap so the 3 stats sit side-by-side

notes.note: Address lookup renders speed/latency/outage cards for 3 providers, zero errors.

notes.change: SLA credit-claim assistant (README next-3 #3 lite): providers with 3+ outages/yr get a 'Claim SLA credit' button generating a copyable credit-request letter; lookup button marked data-core.
